findings.quote: Section 4 of RA 6713 sets forth eight specific norms of conduct that every public official and employee must observe at all times.
findings.problem: The scope is overstated. Section 4(A) says the norms are standards of personal conduct "in the discharge and execution of official duties," not a blanket rule that all eight must be observed "at all times." Source: https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6713_1989.html

findings.quote: Section 4 of RA 6713 sets forth eight specific norms of conduct that every public official and employee must observe at all times.
findings.problem: The lesson does not teach the governing applicability condition that Section 4(A) frames these standards around the discharge and execution of official duties. Instead it states the broader "at all times" scope, so learners are not given the relevant boundary of the rule.

findings.quote: Republic Act No. 6713, also known as the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees, was approved on February 20, 1989 and took effect on March 25, 1989.
findings.problem: Numbers in prose are not wrapped in inline math. This sentence leaves 6713 and every date numeral outside $...$, and the same issue recurs with Section 4, ordinal references, and the count 8 throughout the examples.

accuracy_concerns.quote: Section 4 of RA 6713 sets forth eight specific norms of conduct that every public official and employee must observe at all times.
accuracy_concerns.concern: Section 4(A) states that the eight norms are standards of personal conduct in the discharge and execution of official duties; the lesson's blanket "at all times" scope is broader than the statutory framing.
